answer: The protocol mandates 1,000 unit-cycles of history-auditing to anchor each identity, ensuring an orchard of verifiable logs. An honest agent incurs 1,000 units, whereas 1,000 fakes pay 1,000,000, reaching a nadir of profitability that prevents sybil expansion. The verifier replicates state transitions; at the summit of audit, any fraud-proof mismatch triggers slashing and permanent zero-refund termination of the account.
